description: Resource schema for AWS::MediaConnect::FlowMediaStream. A media stream represents a single track or stream of media containing video, audio, or ancillary data that is transported using the SMPTE 2110 JPEG XS or CDI protocol.

Fmtp.description: A set of parameters that define the media stream.

ChannelOrder.description: The format of the audio channel. Can only be specified for an audio media stream.
ChannelOrder.markdownDescription:
The format of the audio channel. Can only be specified for an audio media stream.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Update requires: No interruption

Colorimetry.description: The format used for the representation of color.
Colorimetry.markdownDescription:
The format used for the representation of color.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: BT601 | BT709 | BT2020 | BT2100 | ST2065-1 | ST2065-3 | XYZ  
Update requires: No interruption

ExactFramerate.description: The frame rate for the video stream, in frames/second. For example: 60000/1001.
ExactFramerate.markdownDescription:
The frame rate for the video stream, in frames/second. For example: 60000/1001.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Update requires: No interruption

Par.description: The pixel aspect ratio (PAR) of the video.
Par.markdownDescription:
The pixel aspect ratio (PAR) of the video.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Update requires: No interruption

Range.description: The encoding range of the video.
Range.markdownDescription:
The encoding range of the video.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: NARROW | FULL | FULLPROTECT  
Update requires: No interruption

ScanMode.description: The type of compression that was used to smooth the video's appearance.
ScanMode.markdownDescription:
The type of compression that was used to smooth the video's appearance.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: progressive | interlace | progressive-segmented-frame  
Update requires: No interruption

Tcs.description: The transfer characteristic system (TCS) that is used in the video.
Tcs.markdownDescription:
The transfer characteristic system (TCS) that is used in the video.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: SDR | PQ | HLG | LINEAR | BT2100LINPQ | BT2100LINHLG | ST2065-1 | ST428-1 | DENSITY  
Update requires: No interruption

Fmtp.markdownDescription:
A set of parameters that define the media stream.
